shared_elements: figure holding a staff or vertical rod
figures facing one another across a central axis
low-relief carving of a scene with figures
a framing band at the base of the scene
justification: Both depict human figures in profile in low relief, some seated, with a vertical staff-like element near a central axis and figures oriented toward one another; but this is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows two large, isolated figures on an empty ground with an elongated naturalistic body canon and fine incised detailing of beard, drapery and furniture, whereas B is a densely packed, horror-vacui composition of squat, blocky figures crowded around a central tree/cross motif and enclosed by ornate scroll and step-fret borders with glyph-like signs, conventions found nowhere in A.
